verses.text: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textZh: 於是各人都回家去了；耶穌卻往橄欖山去，

verses.text: Early in the morning He came again into the temple, and all the people were coming to Him; and He sat down and [began] to teach them.
verses.textZh: 清早又回到殿裡。眾百姓都到他那裡去，他就坐下，教訓他們。

verses.text: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman caught in adultery, and having set her in the center [of the court],
verses.textZh: 文士和法利賽人帶著一個行淫時被拿的婦人來，叫他站在當中，

verses.text: they said to Him, 'Teacher, this woman has been caught in adultery, in the very act.
verses.textZh: 就對耶穌說：夫子，這婦人是正行淫之時被拿的。

verses.text: 'Now in the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women; what then do You say?'
verses.textZh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你說該把他怎麼樣呢？

verses.text: They were saying this, testing Him, so that they might have grounds for accusing Him. But Jesus stooped down and with His finger wrote on the ground.
verses.textZh: 他們說這話，乃試探耶穌，要得著告他的把柄。耶穌卻彎著腰，用指頭在地上畫字。

verses.text: But when they persisted in asking Him, He straightened up, and said to them, 'He who is without sin among you, let him [be the] first to throw a stone at her.'
verses.textZh: 他們還是不住的問他，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說：你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就可以先拿石頭打他。

verses.text: Again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.
verses.textZh: 於是又彎著腰，用指頭在地上畫字。

verses.text: When they heard it, they [began] to go out one by one, beginning with the older ones, and He was left alone, and the woman, where she was, in the center [of the court].
verses.textZh: 他們聽見這話，就從老到少，一個一個的都出去了，只剩下耶穌一人，還有那婦人仍然站在當中。

verses.text: Straightening up, Jesus said to her, 'Woman, where are they? Did no one condemn you?'
verses.textZh: 耶穌就直起腰來，對他說：婦人，那些人在那裡呢？沒有人定你的罪麼？

verses.text: She said, 'No one, Lord.' And Jesus said, 'I do not condemn you, either. Go. From now on sin no more.]'
verses.textZh: 他說：主阿，沒有。耶穌說：我也不定你的罪。去罷，從此不要再犯罪了！

verses.text: Then Jesus again spoke to them, saying, 'I am the Light of the world; he who follows Me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the Light of life.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌又對眾人說：我是世界的光。跟從我的，就不在黑暗裡走，必要得著生命的光。

verses.text: So the Pharisees said to Him, 'You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not true.'
verses.textZh: 法利賽人對他說：你是為自己作見證，你的見證不真。

verses.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is true, for I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：我雖然為自己作見證，我的見證還是真的；因我知道我從那裡來，往那裡去；你們卻不知道我從那裡來，往那裡去。

verses.text: 'You judge according to the flesh; I am not judging anyone.
verses.textZh: 你們是以外貌（原文是憑肉身）判斷人，我卻不判斷人。

verses.text: 'But even if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone [in it], but I and the Father who sent Me.
verses.textZh: 就是判斷人，我的判斷也是真的；因為不是我獨自在這裡，還有差我來的父與我同在。

verses.text: 'Even in your law it has been written that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.textZh: 你們的律法上也記著說：兩個人的見證是真的。

verses.text: 'I am He who testifies about Myself, and the Father who sent Me testifies about Me.'
verses.textZh: 我是為自己作見證，還有差我來的父也是為我作見證。

verses.text: So they were saying to Him, 'Where is Your Father?' Jesus answered, 'You know neither Me nor My Father; if you knew Me, you would know My Father also.'
verses.textZh: 他們就問他說：你的父在那裡？耶穌回答說：你們不認識我，也不認識我的父；若是認識我，也就認識我的父。

verses.text: These words He spoke in the treasury, as He taught in the temple; and no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
verses.textZh: 這些話是耶穌在殿裡的庫房、教訓人時所說的，也沒有人拿他，因為他的時候還沒有到。

verses.text: Then He said again to them, 'I go away, and you will seek Me, and will die in your sin; where I am going, you cannot come.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌又對他們說：我要去了，你們要找我，並且你們要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你們不能到。

verses.text: So the Jews were saying, 'Surely He will not kill Himself, will He, since He says, 'Where I am going, you cannot come '?'
verses.textZh: 猶太人說：他說：我所去的地方，你們不能到，難道他要自盡麼？

verses.text: And He was saying to them, 'You are from below, I am from above; you are of this world, I am not of this world.
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他們說：你們是從下頭來的，我是從上頭來的；你們是屬這世界的，我不是屬這世界的。

verses.text: 'Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am [He], you will die in your sins.'
verses.textZh: 所以我對你們說，你們要死在罪中。你們若不信我是基督，必要死在罪中。

verses.text: So they were saying to Him, 'Who are You?' Jesus said to them, 'What have I been saying to you [from] the beginning?
verses.textZh: 他們就問他說：你是誰？耶穌對他們說：就是我從起初所告訴你們的。

verses.text: 'I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you, but He who sent Me is true; and the things which I heard from Him, these I speak to the world.'
verses.textZh: 我有許多事講論你們，判斷你們；但那差我來的是真的，我在他那裡所聽見的，我就傳給世人。

verses.text: They did not realize that He had been speaking to them about the Father.
verses.textZh: 他們不明白耶穌是指著父說的。

verses.text: So Jesus said, 'When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am [He], and I do nothing on My own initiative, but I speak these things as the Father taught Me.
verses.textZh: 所以耶穌說：你們舉起人子以後，必知道我是基督，並且知道我沒有一件事是憑著自己作的。我說這些話乃是照著父所教訓我的。

verses.text: 'And He who sent Me is with Me; He has not left Me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to Him.'
verses.textZh: 那差我來的是與我同在；他沒有撇下我獨自在這裡，因為我常做他所喜悅的事。

verses.text: As He spoke these things, many came to believe in Him.
verses.textZh: 耶穌說這話的時候，就有許多人信他。

verses.text: So Jesus was saying to those Jews who had believed Him, 'If you continue in My word, [then] you are truly disciples of Mine;
verses.textZh: 耶穌對信他的猶太人說：你們若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的門徒；

verses.text: and you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.'
verses.textZh: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。

verses.text: They answered Him, 'We are Abraham's descendants and have never yet been enslaved to anyone; how is it that You say, 'You will become free '?'
verses.textZh: 他們回答說：我們是亞伯拉罕的後裔，從來沒有作過誰的奴僕。你怎麼說你們必得自由呢？

verses.text: Jesus answered them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who commits sin is the slave of sin.
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：我實實在在的告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。

verses.text: 'The slave does not remain in the house forever; the son does remain forever.
verses.textZh: 奴僕不能永遠住在家裡；兒子是永遠住在家裡。

verses.text: 'So if the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.textZh: 所以天父的兒子若叫你們自由，你們就真自由了。

verses.text: 'I know that you are Abraham's descendants; yet you seek to kill Me, because My word has no place in you.
verses.textZh: 我知道你們是亞伯拉罕的子孫，你們卻想要殺我，因為你們心裡容不下我的道。

verses.text: 'I speak the things which I have seen with [My] Father; therefore you also do the things which you heard from [your] father.'
verses.textZh: 我所說的是在我父那裡看見的；你們所行的是在你們的父那裡聽見的。

verses.text: They answered and said to Him, 'Abraham is our father.' Jesus said to them, 'If you are Abraham's children, do the deeds of Abraham.
verses.textZh: 他們說：我們的父就是亞伯拉罕。耶穌說：你們若是亞伯拉罕的兒子，就必行亞伯拉罕所行的事。

verses.text: 'But as it is, you are seeking to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.
verses.textZh: 我將在神那裡所聽見的真理告訴了你們，現在你們卻想要殺我，這不是亞伯拉罕所行的事。

verses.text: 'You are doing the deeds of your father.' They said to Him, 'We were not born of fornication; we have one Father: God.'
verses.textZh: 你們是行你們父所行的事。他們說：我們不是從淫亂生的；我們只有一位父，就是神。

verses.text: Jesus said to them, 'If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I proceeded forth and have come from God, for I have not even come on My own initiative, but He sent Me.
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：倘若神是你們的父，你們就必愛我；因為我本是出於神，也是從神而來，並不是由著自己來，乃是他差我來。

verses.text: 'Why do you not understand what I am saying? [It is] because you cannot hear My word.
verses.textZh: 你們為甚麼不明白我的話呢？無非是因你們不能聽我的道。

verses.text: 'You are of [your] father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own [nature], for he is a liar and the father of lies.
verses.textZh: 你們是出於你們的父魔鬼，你們父的私慾你們偏要行。他從起初是殺人的，不守真理，因他心裡沒有真理。他說謊是出於自己；因他本來是說謊的，也是說謊之人的父。

verses.text: 'But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me.
verses.textZh: 我將真理告訴你們，你們就因此不信我。

verses.text: 'Which one of you convicts Me of sin? If I speak truth, why do you not believe Me?
verses.textZh: 你們中間誰能指證我有罪呢？我既然將真理告訴你們，為甚麼不信我呢？

verses.text: 'He who is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear [them], because you are not of God.'
verses.textZh: 出於神的，必聽神的話；你們不聽，因為你們不是出於神。

verses.text: The Jews answered and said to Him, 'Do we not say rightly that You are a Samaritan and have a demon?'
verses.textZh: 猶太人回答說：我們說你是撒瑪利亞人，並且是鬼附著的，這話豈不正對麼？

verses.text: Jesus answered, 'I do not have a demon; but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：我不是鬼附著的；我尊敬我的父，你們倒輕慢我。

verses.text: 'But I do not seek My glory; there is One who seeks and judges.
verses.textZh: 我不求自己的榮耀，有一位為我求榮耀、定是非的。

verses.text: 'Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he will never see death.'
verses.textZh: 我實實在在的告訴你們，人若遵守我的道，就永遠不見死。

verses.text: The Jews said to Him, 'Now we know that You have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets [also]; and You say, 'If anyone keeps My word, he will never taste of death.'
verses.textZh: 猶太人對他說：現在我們知道你是鬼附著的。亞伯拉罕死了，眾先知也死了，你還說：人若遵守我的道，就永遠不嘗死味。

verses.text: 'Surely You are not greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died too; whom do You make Yourself out [to be]?'
verses.textZh: 難道你比我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕還大麼？他死了，眾先知也死了，你將自己當作甚麼人呢？

verses.text: Jesus answered, 'If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; it is My Father who glorifies Me, of whom you say, 'He is our God';
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：我若榮耀自己，我的榮耀就算不得甚麼；榮耀我的乃是我的父，就是你們所說是你們的神。

verses.text: and you have not come to know Him, but I know Him; and if I say that I do not know Him, I will be a liar like you, but I do know Him and keep His word.
verses.textZh: 你們未曾認識他；我卻認識他。我若說不認識他，我就是說謊的，像你們一樣；但我認識他，也遵守他的道。

verses.text: 'Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw [it] and was glad.'
verses.textZh: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡歡喜喜的仰望我的日子，既看見了就快樂。

verses.text: So the Jews said to Him, 'You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?'
verses.textZh: 猶太人說：你還沒有五十歲，豈見過亞伯拉罕呢？

verses.text: Jesus said to them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was born, I am.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：我實實在在的告訴你們，還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我。

verses.text: Therefore they picked up stones to throw at Him, but Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple.
verses.textZh: 於是他們拿石頭要打他；耶穌卻躲藏，從殿去了。
